digest.component_or_area: bridge and tracker sync unified command interface
propositions: Bridge redesign consolidates fragmented Jira-specific operator surface into one provider-neutral Python-first command interface with canonical verbs (setup, check-access, fsck, status, preview, sync, pause, resume).
Canonical exit codes are 0, 1, and 2; legacy adapters retain historical 3, 4, and 75 translations for backward compatibility with existing workflows.
Argument-less `bridge sync` is mutating (live); argument-less `reconcile` remains non-mutating (dry-run) through explicit compatibility adapters.
Python core owns tickets-branch CAS delivery (src/rebar/_store/push.py); no workflow-local CAS retry loop or gh CLI dependency remains.
Bridge functionality is unified across Python library, CLI (rebar bridge), and MCP server interfaces; all three routes share the same core implementation.
Pause state is durable, includes reason, and supports mixed-version fleet reads; local, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, and bare environments use the same runner-neutral core.
